## Historical audit — S0227

**Source:** `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/outputs/scene_rsi_v2_1/results/r1/scene_rsi_v2_1/C2/development/commons_187101683/trajectory.jsonl`. This audit covers only supplied chunk 2; the referenced images and other chunk are not visible here.

| Evidence | Observation and limit |
|---|---|
| Student `model_request`, line 13, characters [0,181775) | The assigned goal was reconstruction from one RGB image, with separate editable objects and matching camera and framing. The student’s inventory **interpreted** the scene as an ochre sofa and tilted pillow, table, two cup sets, flower arrangement, wall, carpet, window and curtain. These are student observations, not independently verified image content. |
| Line 13, same offsets, first program and step 1 result | The program defined multiple named assets and child parts: cushions and arms, table legs and apron, hollow cups and handles, stems and leaves. It specified colors, procedural bump textures, a camera and two lights. Hierarchy and intended contact do not independently establish correct connections, pose, occlusion or appearance. The runner reported `ok: true`, completed 16 samples and saved a render. |
| Line 13, same offsets, revised program | The student described the first sofa as too small, the camera too high, top surfaces too visible, the curtain narrow/light/rigid and foliage too narrow. These are **student diagnoses**, not verified defects. The executed revision lowered and moved the camera, widened the table, shifted the table and its objects together, expanded foliage, reshaped/darkened curtain folds, and changed materials and lighting. The pillow remained explicitly tilted. |
| Line 13, same offsets, step 2 result; line 14 `codex_session`, [0,3844); line 15 `model_response`, [0,349) | The second execution also reported `ok: true`, completed 16 samples and saved a render. The final session received paths for reference and both renders, recorded no tool calls, and returned `DONE`. The instructions stated that the last successful build would be submitted automatically; the excerpt does not independently show the submission artifact. |

**Teacher and exploration.** No teacher message, detection, diagnosis or proposed update is visible in this chunk, so neither teacher receipt nor adoption is established. The student’s own render comparison and revision constitute visible autonomous exploration; the final session shows no further tool-based exploration.

**Outcome and uncertainty.** Both builds formally executed and rendered; this is not evidence of geometric or visual correctness. The final reconstruction’s completeness, material fidelity, part contacts, camera framing, illumination and any remaining render defects are unknown without the images. No failure, empty patch or technical interruption is shown; visual success or partial correctness cannot be classified from the text alone.

**Lessons.** Transferable: retain editable parts, distinguish a reported render from a verified match, and coordinate supported-object offsets when moving a support. Task-specific: the stated sofa, curtain and foliage diagnoses motivated this particular revision. Whether those diagnoses or the simultaneous camera, geometry and lighting changes improved the match remains unresolved.
